jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist

The Role We Need:

We are seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist dedicated to supporting supply-side growth by building, optimizing, and scaling communication journeys for our Host community. In this role, you won't just monitor existing flow, you will actively design, build, and deploy data-driven campaigns across the entire host lifecycle: driving initial lead acquisition, nurturing prospective hosts into qualified opportunities, guiding them through activation, and securing long-term retention. Utilizing our core stack and Segment, you will bridge marketing operations and technical execution to build multi-channel experiences across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-obsessed builder who understands how lifecycle marketing touches every stage of the host journey. While you keep the big picture in mind, you thrive in the tactical details that make campaigns succeed. You are a strong team player who excels in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns align with broader business goals.

As a hands-on Specialist, you focus on practical execution. You can take a campaign brief and event payload to build end-to-end journeys, defining triggers, eligibility, exclusions, and exit criteria, or analyze a broken workflow to find and fix the root cause. You combine strong technical skills across our platforms (leveraging Pardot, SFMC, and Salesforce CRM for supply-side pipeline management while driving high-volume campaigns in Iterable) with a critical eye, knowing when to verify data anomalies and overlapping flows before launching a campaign.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:

  • Build, Execute & Optimize Lifecycle Journeys: Design, build, execute, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and other owned channels to engage prospective and active hosts effectively.
  • Manage Automation Flow Performance: Monitor and maintain automation flows to ensure campaigns are delivered consistently and perform at a high level.
  • Manage & Integrate Marketing Stack: Work directly inside Iterable, Pardot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and Salesforce CRM to ensure seamless data flow, segment syncs, lead scoring, and campaign triggering across host lifecycle stages.
  • Troubleshoot HTML and CSS: Troubleshoot HTML and CSS issues to ensure communications render properly across various devices and platforms.
  • Conduct A/B Testing: Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to identify strategies that optimize user engagement and campaign success.
  • Analyze Performance Data Insights: Analyze performance data and generate insights to enhance the effectiveness of marketing strategies.
  • Collaborate on Campaign Content: Collaborate with creative and cross-functional teams to refine content and visuals for multi-channel campaigns.

Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

  • Marketing Automation & Stack Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, or automation, with a proven track record of building workflows from scratch. Direct experience using Iterable, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
  • Audience Segmentation & Data Verification: Working knowledge of SQL (or platform segmentation engines) to query audience tables, validate host event data, and build targeted segments.
  • System Connections & Event Triggers: Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and Webhooks to understand event mappings and help trigger real-time, automated flows. Able to communicate technical requirements effectively with Product and Data teams.
  • Dynamic Content & Personalization: Practical experience using scripting languages (such as Liquid syntax, AMPscript, or basic JavaScript) to apply conditional logic and render personalized content.
  • Email Template & HTML Troubleshooting: Functional knowledge of HTML/CSS to make edits, update layouts, and troubleshoot responsive email templates across devices.
  • A/B Testing Expertise: Experience in A/B testing and the ability to interpret results to drive improvements.
  • Prioritization Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Stay Updated on Trends: Knowledge of multi-channel marketing trends and best practices to stay ahead in a competitive industry.
  • Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and quality in all aspects of marketing execution.

The Interview Process:

  1. Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  2. If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  3. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Sr Lifecycle Marketing Automation Specialist for thirty (30) minutes.
  4. If warranted, the next step would be a forty-five (45) minute interview with our Director of Lifecycle Marketing.
  5. If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with a small panel of key stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would execute a live assessment to the panel for discussion.
  6. If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer

Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us and make mental healthcare more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand.

At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.
  • You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.
  • You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.
  • You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.
  • You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.
  • You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.
  • You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.
  • You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.
  • Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.
  • At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.
  • Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.
  • Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.
  • A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.
  • Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.
  • Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.
  • Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.
  • Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.
  • Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.

Bonus (Helpful, but not required)

  • Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.
  • Experience with React or Next.js.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.description:
People Partner 
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

Compensation

The Role

We're looking for a proactive, pragmatic People Partner to join us on a fixed-term basis at a pivotal part of our growth journey.

Working closely with the Senior People Partner, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the People Partnering (HRBP) model deeper into a fully-remote scale-up. You'll strengthen line manager capability, while partnering with the wider team to embed our capability frameworks as we move to a High Performance model.

You'll also pick up ER casework as and when required, providing practical support to line managers and employees. Reporting to the Director of People & Talent, you'll be a trusted point of contact across the business while getting stuck into the initiatives that shape how we work.

This is a great opportunity for a People Partner who's ready to bring strong partnering skills that drive immediate positive outcomes, balancing commercial priorities with the needs of our people. In pursuit of this you will ideally draw upon a blend of established and newer HRBP practice, applied to a purpose-led, fully-remote scale-up. A genuine interest in what we do is important too - we're looking for someone who'll always keep our members and their pets in mind.

What you'll be doing

People Partnering & Projects:

People Partners empower managers and SLT to make their teams and functions as effective as they can be, through supporting high performance, diagnosing the root cause of team issues, and amplifying capability across the business.

  • Work alongside the Senior People Partner to fully embed the HRBP (People Partnering) model across our functions in a fully-remote, scale-up environment, with People Partners embedded into specific functions as trusted strategic advisors to SLT and managers.
  • Act as a strategic sounding board for SLT and managers, always looking to understand the "why" behind a decision, pulling this back to our purpose, our members and our commercial goals, and leading with kindness throughout.
  • Get under the skin of team and functional issues, diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms, and using this insight to amplify manager and team capability.
  • Support the development and roll-out of capability frameworks (including feedback models, ways of working & role capabilities) as we move towards a High Performance model

    ER Advisory:

  • Pick up ER casework as and when required, providing timely, pragmatic support to managers and employees through investigation processes and outcomes.


What we're looking for:

  • Experience in a People Partner or HRBP role, ideally within a fully-remote, fast-paced scale-up.

  • Understanding and hands-on experience of embedding the HRBP model within a People Function, ideally within a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • A dual lens of commercial acumen and people advocacy, ensuring people decisions are grounded in business reality without losing sight of the human impact

  • Comfortable leading or supporting on disciplinary and grievance investigations.

  • Solid knowledge of UK employment law, HR policy and best practice.

  • Confident advising and building relationships with managers and employees at all levels.

  • A genuine interest in connecting people initiatives to wider business goals, with a naturally curious, solutions-focused mindset - particularly around manager capability and High Performance.

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to balance pragmatism with empathy and a strong sense of fairness.

  • Experience working in a fully-remote environment, ideally within a scale-up moving towards a High Performance culture.

  • CIPD Level 5 qualified (or equivalent hands-on experience).

  • Experience using HRIS platforms (we use Humaans) and Google Workspace is a plus.

You’ll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply.

You’ll feel like a fish out of water if:

  • You want a market with the rules already written - we're creating something that hasn't existed before, so uncertainty comes with the territory

  • You don't connect with purpose-led work - we're deeply driven by our purpose and commitment to people, pets & planet (and proud to be a B-Corp), so this needs to genuinely matter to you. Our members and their pets are at the heart of everything we do!

  • You need the process mapped out before you'll move - we're still writing the playbook, not handing you one

  • You want policy to be black and white - we’re working with humans meaning we often work in the grey, and we trust you to use judgement, not just the rulebook

  • You like everything scoped before you start - here, you'll often be figuring it out as you go

  • You're looking for a People Partnering machine to step into - you'd be one of the people building it

  • You do your best thinking alone - we're a small team, and we lean on each other and value collaboration and input

  • You need the buzz of an office to feel like you're at work - this role is genuinely remote, so you'll need to bring your own momentum

  • You like things to stay still - priorities shift fast here, and we need you to shift with them

Contract details

  • Fixed-term contract, 14–18 months

  • Reports to: Senior People Partner

  • Salary: Up to £75,000, depending on experience

  • Ideal start date: October 2026

  • Remote-first (UK-based)

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed twice a year
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

jobs.title: Applied Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (Decision Intelligence)
jobs.description:
Applied Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (Decision Intelligence)

We are looking for a product-minded Applied Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer to help build, ship, and scale ML-powered products that directly improve how our customers make decisions, operate their businesses, and serve their own users.

This is not a research-only role, nor is it a service-oriented internal analytics position. We want someone who has taken machine learning from problem definition through experimentation, production deployment, measurement, iteration, and long-term ownership. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, measurable, scalable, and valuable inside a real product.

Whether your background leans heavily toward Data Engineering/ML Ops or Applied Data Science, you have a strong bias toward shipping and an interest in bridging both worlds to bring AI to life.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Engineering & AI Enablement

  • End-to-End ML Ownership: Drive the development of machine learning capabilities (forecasting, recommendation, ranking, optimization, or decision intelligence) powering customer-facing SaaS products.

  • Pipeline & Model Development: Design reliable data and feature pipelines alongside models from discovery through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Product Integration: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to embed ML directly into product workflows, user experiences, and decision-making tools.

  • Pragmatic Prototyping: Move quickly from prototype to production while balancing accuracy, interpretability, latency, maintainability, and business impact.

    • Ecosystem Ownership & Strategy

  • Evaluation & Experimentation: Define offline and online evaluation strategies, including model quality, drift, and reliability. Design A/B tests and causal measurement frameworks to prove ML features improve customer outcomes.

  • Data Health & Feedback Loops: Collaborate with Data teams to ensure models are supported by high-quality features, while building feedback loops so product experiences improve over time.

  • Platform & MLOps Support: Help manage and optimize cloud data infrastructure, ensuring trustworthy insights and proactively managing data health before it impacts users.

    • Product & Technical Direction

  • Strategic Judgment: Bring strong judgment around when to use traditional ML, statistical modeling, LLMs, heuristics, or simpler product logic. Make practical trade-offs across model complexity and customer impact.

  • Roadmap Influence: Clearly communicate what ML can and cannot solve to influence roadmap decisions, helping identify where machine learning can create true product differentiation.

  • Mentorship: Guide and mentor other data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and cross-functional partners in applied ML best practices.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • The Proven Builder: You have shipped ML into real products. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous product problem, figuring out if ML is the right solution, building it, and measuring whether it worked.

  • Product-First Architect: You care about product impact as much as model performance. You know that a model with slightly lower accuracy but higher trust, faster inference, better explainability, and stronger user adoption is the better product decision.

  • A Multi-Disciplinary Executioner: You understand that a model is only as good as the pipeline feeding it. You prioritize usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Experience: 3+ years (ideally 5+) of professional experience in applied data science, machine learning, or ML engineering, including hands-on experience building and shipping models into production products. Experience with SaaS products is highly valued.

  • Technical Core: Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with applied ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow). Solid SQL expertise is required.

  • ML & Modeling Depth: Strong understanding of supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation systems, optimization, or statistical modeling. Experience with real-world, imperfect product datasets is essential.

  • Ops & Orchestration: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (model versioning, feature pipelines, orchestration via Airflow/dbt/Dagster, monitoring, drift detection) and modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience operating within cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to product, engineering, and non-technical business stakeholders.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience with decision intelligence, forecasting, customer behavior modeling, workforce/route optimization, or operational intelligence products.

  • Experience with LLMs, GenAI, or agentic workflows applied to real product use cases.

  • Prior experience acting as a Senior or Lead scientist responsible for guiding technical direction.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:
• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us! 
 
LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT: 
• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. 
 
A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:
 • We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming. 
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.
 
RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED: 
• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match
AND BEYOND...
• Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays
• Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave
• Tuition reimbursement
• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!
• 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc
• Quarterly awards based on peer nominations
• Regional discounts and perks
• Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community 
 
GROW WITH US: 
• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth
• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!
• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year 
 
JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM! 
• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!
• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine

jobs.description:
E-Commerce Campaign Manager (All Genders)
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we’re on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We create the snacks people genuinely crave, from chocolate bars and wafers to cookies, gummies, and protein bars, with up to 90% less sugar and no compromise on taste.

As our E-Commerce Campaign Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of our products, customer experience, and commercial growth. You’ll help shape how ahead brings ideas to life online and scales them across markets.

You’ll take ownership of our onsite campaigns and bring our overarching campaign strategy to life in our shop. You’ll improve the processes behind them, develop & implement new ideas for new campaign-related shop features, and turn campaign data into actionable insights. Working closely with our E-Commerce, Campaign, Brand, and Marketing teams, you’ll help make our campaigns more effective, scalable, and relevant across markets.

If you’re commercially curious, highly detail oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to shape both the customer experience and the way we do e-commerce, we’d love to hear from you!


YOUR TASKS

  • Onsite Campaign Experience & Launches: Plan and execute product launches, discount initiatives, and other commercial activities in the shop. Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Content & Asset Ownership: Coordinate the creation of product and shop content, including images, copy, homepage content, launch pages, and other onsite assets. Take full responsibility for their quality, accuracy, and timely delivery, including localization for expansion markets. Ensure content is adapted to local needs and delivered consistently across countries.

  • Shop Development: Together with our Tech team, transform the campaign vision into new shop features, promotional mechanics, and onsite experiences that can improve customer engagement and commercial performance.

  • Process Improvement: Improve how onsite activities are planned, created, and delivered by establishing clearer workflows, strengthening collaboration and handovers, and reducing avoidable errors. Find ways to shorten delivery timelines and assess recurring tasks for automation or AI support. Develop scalable ways of working while using sound judgment about where communication, coordination, and creative thinking remain essential.

  • Performance & Insights: Analyze completed onsite activities, from product launch revenue and discount uplift to top-selling products and other relevant performance indicators, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for future initiatives.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You have practical experience in onsite campaign management, shop management, e-commerce, or a similar field. Hands-on experience with onsite campaigns or shop management is essential. 

  • You are highly organized, structured, and accurate. You have a low tolerance for errors and take full responsibility for the quality of your work, particularly when managing product copy, campaign assets, and launch details.

  • You combine attention to detail with commercial curiosity. You don’t just execute campaigns – you want to understand what drives performance, what can be improved, and how new ideas can create better results. 

  • You are proactive and hands-on. You identify problems, challenge inefficient processes, and follow through on solutions. You’re comfortable working across a broad range of tasks in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in both German and English. You enjoy coordinating with multiple stakeholders and can work effectively with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand & Design, and other internal teams.

  • You have a basic understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing, and e-commerce performance.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • You are confident working with Shopify. Hands-on Shopify experience is essential for this role.

  • You have worked in a D2C business.

  • You are familiar with Asana, Trello, or similar project management tools.

  • You understand shop and e-commerce performance and how onsite activities can contribute to commercial results.

  • A background in food, consumer goods, retail, or another high-campaign environment is a plus.

Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
About us

NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. 

Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights.
We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data.
  • Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users.
  • Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems.
  • Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps.
  • Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform.

Your profile

jobs.description:
Senior Controller (f/m/d)
About

Chrono24 is the world's leading marketplace for luxury watches, bringing together watch enthusiasts, collectors, dealers, and buyers from all over the world every day. As a Senior Controller, you'll be part of our Controlling team and actively help shape Chrono24's financial steering. You'll ensure that operational developments are translated into financial impact, take ownership of ongoing cost and P&L controlling including monthly and quarterly reporting, develop scalable controlling and planning processes, and support the Management Board in data-driven decision-making. This role gives you the opportunity to substantially advance our controlling structures — from cost transparency all the way to integrated planning.


What you can expect

  • Financial Steering & Decision Support: You translate operational KPI developments into P&L, EBITDA, and cash impact, and prepare well-founded executive and board materials including commentary
  • Planning, Forecasting & Budget Steering: You drive budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecast processes, steer budgets together with the business units, and develop driver-based financial models as well as integrated cash and working capital planning

  • Reporting & Month-End Close: You support the monthly and quarterly close from a controlling perspective, comment on cost and earnings developments, and further develop management and business-unit reporting
  • Systems, Automation & AI: You drive the integration of financials into our data landscape, automate manual processes, and develop AI-supported analysis and commentary workflows
  • Financial Governance: You ensure consistent financial logic (segments, P&L structure, forecast logic) in alignment with BI and Accounting


What sets you apart

  • At least 5 years of experience in Controlling or FP&A, ideally in a digital marketplace or e-commerce environment
  • Solid controlling expertise across the full breadth: cost and P&L controlling, reporting and variance analysis, as well as planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis

jobs.description:
Robotics Engineer

About Augur

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to join our growing technical team in London and take ownership of the integration of a new counter-UAS initiative.

 

This role sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning and systems engineering, and you'll own the integration across all three. You'll prove out the concept, build the prototype, and take it into trials, working closely with product partners and other stakeholders along the way.

 

The role is highly interdisciplinary, so we're less concerned with ticking every box than with finding someone motivated, curious, and willing to learn. Across the project, you'll draw on areas such as:

 

  • Machine learning and computer vision

  • Sensors and camera modelling

  • State estimation and sensor fusion

  • Control theory

  • Modelling and simulation

  • Low-level programming and hardware/software integration

 

We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these. If you're strong in some and excited to grow into the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • A degree in robotics, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or a related field - or another engineering background backed by hands-on hardware/software integration work.

  • Strong programming skills in a low-level language (C, C++ or Rust), plus Python.

  • A working understanding of modern computer vision, including object detection and tracking, and experience training, optimising, and deploying models for real-time or resource-constrained use.

  • Hands-on experience with state estimation and sensor fusion - using techniques such as Kalman filtering and factor graphs to combine noisy sensor data into reliable estimates - and with the problems they underpin, such as SLAM.

  • A solid grasp of sensors and how to model them: you understand how real sensors behave, particularly cameras, and can represent them with appropriate models (e.g. camera and distortion models).

  • Self-directed initiative: you can take an unfamiliar problem, get up to speed through your own research, and clearly document and share your findings so others can build on them.

  • Strong communication skills: you can explain technical work clearly and work effectively with external partners and suppliers.

 
 

Nice to Have

 

  • A working knowledge of control theory, particularly designing and tuning PID controllers for closed-loop systems.

  • Experience developing and testing systems before committing to hardware, from numerical modelling through to 3D simulation.

  • Familiarity with RF and RF-based sensing, including how RF sensors and sensor arrays work.

Accessibility and inclusivity

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.

The role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you are the first commercial point of contact with our prospects. You join Zefir's Sales team and reach out to homeowners who have run a valuation on our website but have not booked an appointment yet.

The core of the role is reactivation: these homeowners showed interest, then stopped there. You are the one who gets them moving again, on the phone, one by one.

Your goal as a BDR: create the sales opportunities that feed our revenue directly.

What you will do

  • Handle around 100 calls per day, with a target of 3 to 4 meetings booked daily.

  • Run qualification calls of about 20 minutes: understand the client's project, present Zefir's value proposition, and book a follow-up meeting with an Account Executive.

  • Keep rigorous track of your pipeline and move leads through the Sales funnel.

  • Work closely with Account Executives to maximize conversion and contribute directly to Zefir's growth.

Career path

We are transparent on this. A BDR role can open the door to an Account Executive role internally, but there is no automatic progression and no guaranteed timeline. Any move depends on three things: performance, behavioral fit, and team needs.

What we can commit to: our Consumer Account Executives, the role a BDR grows into, and our Sales Managers are filled exclusively through internal mobility. We never open these roles externally. Top performers are rewarded, with uncapped variable pay and real visibility.

  • 0 to 2 years of experience. This role is designed for a junior profile who wants to learn sales on the phone, fast and in the fiel d.

  • Energized by performance and intensity, with a client and results orientation.

One honest note: this role is intense and repetitive by design. Around a hundred calls a day, every day, with rejection along the way. That is what makes you improve fast at sales, and it is not for everyone.

Senior Product Designer

Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. jobs.title: Research Engineer — Vision & Perception
jobs.description:
Research Engineer — Vision & Perception

About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in our physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

The role

We are hiring Research Scientists in Vision & Perception to design the perception stack that makes our robots understand their environment well enough to act in it reliably. Your work will define how our robots see the world, what they recognize, how robustly, and from how little data.

Industrial environments are visually complex, varied, and unforgiving: changing lighting, cluttered scenes, novel objects, and a hard requirement to work in production without supervision. The perception layer has to deliver the spatial and semantic understanding required for learned manipulation policies to succeed, across the many tasks, objects, and sites we will deploy on. Hitting our one-hour demonstration-to-deployment target depends directly on perception methods that work robustly out of the box, with minimal site-specific tuning.

This is a research role focused on shipping algorithms into a real product. We are an early-stage company and do not publish at this stage. You will work in close collaboration with the Robot Learning and Integration teams to ensure the methods you develop run on real robots, in real factories.

Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and evaluate perception algorithms for robotic manipulation — object recognition, segmentation, pose estimation, scene understanding, and related areas

  • Advance our internal state of the art in perception for embodied agents, with a focus on robustness and data efficiency

  • Run rigorous experiments on real robots, and contribute to the data, evaluation, and infrastructure needed to do so (we will support you in ramping up on robotics if your background is primarily in vision)

  • Translate research prototypes into perception components robust enough to ship as part of our product

  • Collaborate with the Robot Learning and Integration teams to move research from prototype to production

  • Help shape the long-term research agenda of the company

The team

The engineering team is organized around three focus areas with multiple contributors each: Integration, Vision & Perception (this role), and Robot Learning. Early hires will help shape the research agenda, engineering practices, hiring, and culture.

Required qualifications

  • PhD or MSc in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, or a closely related field, from a leading research lab or strong experience in research environments

  • Track record of published research at top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS, or equivalent

  • Demonstrated research expertise in computer vision or machine perception — object recognition, segmentation, pose estimation, scene understanding, 3D perception, or representation learning for vision

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with PyTorch

  • Hands-on experience training, evaluating, and debugging modern vision systems

  • Professional proficiency in English (internal working language)

Preferred qualifications

The strongest candidates will combine deep research expertise with experience across several of the following:

  • 3D vision — depth estimation, geometric reasoning, point cloud processing, or 3D scene reconstruction

  • Perception for robotic manipulation, including grasping and interaction

  • Experience working with real robots (any platform — humanoids, arms, mobile bases)

  • Postdoctoral experience, or research positions in industry labs or top academic groups

  • A history of translating research into deployed systems

What we offer

  • A clear, ambitious research mission with measurable real-world impact

  • A diverse fleet of advanced robots, including humanoids, on which to run your research

  • Research that ships: your algorithms run on real machines in real factories

  • Tight collaboration with engineering teams that take your work to production

  • Significant ownership of the research agenda as an early member of the team

  • A focused, technically strong team and a serious engineering culture

  • English-speaking working environment, no French required

  • Fair compensation + equity

jobs.description:
Advanced R&D - Internship - Communication System Modelling

Kandou is redefining AI infrastructure through innovative interconnect technologies that significantly reduce power consumption while maintaining high bandwidth and ultra-low latency. Our mission is to make AI systems more scalable, efficient, and accessible.

 

Today we have one internship position available for max 6 months, in our Advanced R&D, for MSc students in the following area :

 

Communication System Modelling Intern

 

Internship Background

Modern computing systems increasingly rely on high-speed serial interfaces to transfer large volumes of data between processors, memory devices, and accelerator chips. Simultaneous bidirectional (SBD) signalling enables both ends of a copper channel to transmit and receive data concurrently over the same physical medium, offering a promising path toward higher bandwidth efficiency without increasing the number of interconnects.

 

Project Objectives

The objective of this internship is to investigate circuit and signal-processing techniques that enable simultaneous bidirectional communication over wideband copper serial links. The student will explore methods for separating the locally transmitted signal from the incoming signal while maintaining high data rates and robust link performance.

Specific goals may include:

  • Reviewing the state of the art in simultaneous bidirectional and full-duplex wireline communication systems;

  • Developing behavioural models of wideband copper channels and transceiver architectures;

  • Studying self-interference cancellation techniques in the analog and/or digital domains;

  • Evaluating the impact of channel impairments, mismatch, and non-idealities on link performance;

  • Designing and simulating key building blocks using Python or circuit-level CAD tools;

  • Assessing achievable data rates, energy efficiency, and implementation complexity.

 

Expected Outcomes

At the end of the internship, the student is expected to:

  • Gain hands-on experience in the design and analysis of high-speed wireline communication systems;

  • Develop simulation models for simultaneous bidirectional serial links;

  • Quantify the benefits and challenges associated with full-duplex operation over copper channels;

  • Present the obtained results in a technical report and oral presentation.

 

Depending on the progress and interests of the student, the work may lead to conference or journal publication opportunities.

 

Desired Background

The project is suitable for motivated Master's students in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or Computer Engineering.

 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Understanding of the building blocks of a digital communication link and factors impacting the link performance (Familiarity with SerDes link components and clock recovery circuits is a plus);

  • Strong background in signal processing, communications;

  • Proficient in at least one of the following programming languages C++, MALTAB, or Python/NumPy;

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight. The Guidance & Control module steers the aircraft, from motion planning and control laws to the flight mode behaviour on top. As its Module Lead, you own the roadmap, the team, and the interfaces to the rest of the company.

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions.

  • Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update.

  • Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces.

  • Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs.

  • Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary.

  • Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone.

  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved.

  • Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage.

  • Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image.

  • Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout.

  • Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git).

  • Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf.

  • Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

jobs.title: Host Account Manager - Emerging Product
jobs.description:
Host Account Manager - Emerging Product

The Role We Need

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager of Emerging Products to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention. This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.

You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call. You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-Day:

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP
  • Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction
  • Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit
  • Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.
  • Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.
  • Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.
  • Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.
  • Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.
PLATFORM, POLICY, AND FINANCIAL FLUENCY
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.
  • Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.
  • Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.
  • Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.
NEW HOST ACTIVATION
  • Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.
  • Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.
  • Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.
  • Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.
ISSUE RESOLUTION AND ESCALATION
  • Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.
  • Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.
  • Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.
  • Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.
  • Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.
TEAM AND PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT
  • Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.
  • Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

  • Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.
  • Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.
  • Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.
  • Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.
  • Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.
  • Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.
  • Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.
  • Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.
  • Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.
  • Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next stage is video interview and meeting with our Host Experience, Team Lead for about thirty (30) minutes where the candidate will participate a live case interview.
  • If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with our Manager of Host Experience for thirty minutes (30). In this round, a candidate will participate a live logic and competency assessment.
  • If warranted, we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to salary, there is a variable compensation component based on performance.

Additional Information

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Contract Argentina

This leader will play a critical role in helping teams navigate complex organizations, focusing heavily on business value realization and building deep executive connections to maximize the customer's investment in Motive. This role works closely with the GM Canada, Sales Operations, Product, Customer Support, and Implementation teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and drive revenue growth across every stage of the customer journey.

We’re looking for a sales-driven, customer-focused leader who thrives in a high-growth environment, understands how to scale account management organizations, and has a track record of building high-performing teams that deliver exceptional revenue and customer outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership and Team Management: Lead a geographically distributed Enterprise and Strategic Account Management sales organization that you’ll partner with on prospecting, account planning, pipeline generation in existing customers, achieving revenue targets
  • Account Ownership & Revenue Growth: Guide the team in full account ownership, driving retention, negotiating renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and closing deals within complex enterprise accounts.
  • Business Value Realization & Executive Alignment: Develop strategies for Account Managers to effectively demonstrate business value realization to complex enterprise customers. Work with the team to proactively monitor customer health and identify risk and expansion opportunities. Ensure the team is successfully building and expanding executive connections across the account base to secure long-term partnerships and upsell opportunities.
  • Talent Development: Recruit, hire, and develop top Enterprise Account Management sales talent. Establish strong coaching frameworks and career development pathways that support the growth of individual contributors and frontline managers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales Operations, Product, Customer Support, and Implementation teams to improve the overall customer lifecycle and support expansion efforts. Bring customer insights back to internal teams to influence product development and enhance the value proposition for enterprise clients.
  • Performance & Sales Insights: Track and analyze key sales metrics, pipeline generation, and renewal forecasting to identify opportunities to strengthen net revenue retention. Use data-driven insights to guide team strategy and sales operational improvements.
  • Executive Customer Engagement: Serve as a senior escalation point and executive sponsor for strategic accounts, helping resolve complex challenges, negotiate major renewals, and ensure strong long-term partnerships.
  • Process Optimization: Develop and refine scalable sales processes, account planning models, and operational playbooks that enable the Account Management organization to consistently hit revenue targets as the business grows.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in SaaS sales, enterprise sales leadership, or revenue-focused account leadership
  • 4+ years managing enterprise-focused sellers or account managers and customer success managers
  • Demonstrated success owning, retaining, and expanding revenue within complex customer segments
  • Strong operational acumen and experience working with tools such as Salesforce, sales analytics dashboards, and revenue forecasting metrics
  • Experience building scalable account management programs that drive retention, renewal, and significant account expansion
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions
  • Proven ability to build and scale quota-carrying teams in fast-growing SaaS environments

Location: Toronto, Canada

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.
